activity.query:
SELECT COALESCE(state, '') AS state,
       COALESCE(wait_event_type, '') AS wait_event_type,
       COALESCE(wait_event, '') AS wait_event,
       count(*) AS connections
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = current_database()
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY connections DESC, state, wait_event_type, wait_event;

database.query:
SELECT datname,
       numbackends,
       xact_commit,
       xact_rollback,
       blks_read,
       blks_hit,
       tup_returned,
       tup_fetched,
       tup_inserted,
       tup_updated,
       tup_deleted,
       deadlocks
FROM pg_stat_database
WHERE datname = current_database();

locks.query:
SELECT COALESCE(mode, '') AS mode,
       granted,
       count(*) AS locks
FROM pg_locks l
LEFT JOIN pg_database d ON l.database = d.oid
WHERE d.datname = current_database()
   OR l.database IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY locks DESC, mode, granted;

relations.query:
SELECT c.relname,
       CASE c.relpersistence
         WHEN 'p' THEN 'logged'
         WHEN 'u' THEN 'unlogged'
         WHEN 't' THEN 'temporary'
         ELSE c.relpersistence::text
       END AS persistence,
       pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_size_bytes
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
  AND c.relkind = 'r'
  AND c.relname IN ('identity_sessions', 'identity_remote_command_nonces')
ORDER BY c.relname;

         WHEN 't' THEN 'temporary'
         ELSE c.relpersistence::text
       END AS persistence,
       pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_size_bytes
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
  AND c.relkind = 'r'
  AND c.relname IN ('identity_sessions', 'identity_remote_command_nonces')
ORDER BY c.relname;

activity.query:
SELECT COALESCE(state, '') AS state,
       COALESCE(wait_event_type, '') AS wait_event_type,
       COALESCE(wait_event, '') AS wait_event,
       count(*) AS connections
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = current_database()
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY connections DESC, state, wait_event_type, wait_event;

database.query:
SELECT datname,
       numbackends,
       xact_commit,
       xact_rollback,
       blks_read,
       blks_hit,
       tup_returned,
       tup_fetched,
       tup_inserted,
       tup_updated,
       tup_deleted,
       deadlocks
FROM pg_stat_database
WHERE datname = current_database();

locks.query:
SELECT COALESCE(mode, '') AS mode,
       granted,
       count(*) AS locks
FROM pg_locks l
LEFT JOIN pg_database d ON l.database = d.oid
WHERE d.datname = current_database()
   OR l.database IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY locks DESC, mode, granted;
